params.message:
Public API: return the version and the taxes per region

The list and the detail of the public website API now carry the version of a vehicle (package) and the registration tax and yearly road tax per region, as the dealer filled them in on the sheet. An empty amount is null.

Portal: De publieke API geeft nu ook de uitvoering van een wagen en de BIV en verkeersbelasting per gewest.
